Subject: A compact industrial ammunition factory viewed isometrically: tall cylindrical dark steel processing tower at left/rear, dense mechanical pipes and orange/copper details, squat adjoining production units at right/front. Carefully preserve the original arrangement, footprint, perspective, silhouette, colors and highlight direction.
